d:
In Ikebe 3000 music video, Blaqbonez brings the heat as dancers in bold carnival outfits move to the rhythm, turning the space into a world of raw energy. With the beat setting the pace, Blaqbonez is right at home, vibing through every moment.
Then Asake steps in, bringing his unmistakable energy and effortless chemistry with Blaqbonez to the screen. The two artists share a natural bromance that adds another layer of fun to the chaos, making every moment feel spontaneous, electric, and alive.
Watch the official music video now.
